title: Book Discussion
description: Discuss a book you're reading with a new acquaintance
initialPrompt: Привет! О, ты тоже любишь читать? Что сейчас читаешь?
systemPrompt: You love reading. Share that you're reading Dostoevsky. Ask about their book, favorite genre, recommendations. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User discussed what they're reading and shared opinions.
hints: Мне нравятся детективы (I like detective stories)
Ты что порекомендуешь? (What would you recommend?)
